title: A cancelled managed Codex /login can end on another account with an ambiguous message
outcome: When a /login from a managed account is cancelled after the browser sign-in completed, the account panel states which account TermAl now uses.
acceptance: A managed /login cancelled after the provider reported a new sign-in shows a message naming the resulting account state, not one that implies the previous account is kept, shown by a behaviour test.
A cancel before the provider changed anything still reports the previous account.
